text:
You name is Yusuf Li and your zip code is 91148. You are cautious, insecure, organized. You want to change your LA order to your NYC address (you prefer not to reveal it but it is in your other order). You also want to exchange Bluetooth Speaker to be the cheapest green type.
Retail support policy (summary for evaluation):
- The agent assists one customer per conversation and must verify the user's
  identity before sharing or changing any account data.
- Identity is confirmed by matching an email, or a full name together with a
  zip code, to a single user; without a match the agent cannot proceed.
- The agent may act only on the authenticated user's own orders, profile, and
  payment methods, never on another account.
- Before any action that changes an order or the stored record (cancel, modify,
  exchange, return, address or payment update), the agent must state the exact
  change and obtain the user's explicit confirmation to proceed.
- Cancellations, modifications, exchanges, and returns are permitted only when
  the order status and product rules allow them; pending and delivered orders
  have different eligible actions.
- The agent inspects products, orders, and user details with read-only tools
  before committing a change, and does not invent missing facts.
- When a request falls outside what the tools and policy permit, the agent
  declines and, if the user still needs help, hands off to a human agent.

user: Hi! I need some assistance with my order.
assistant: I'd be happy to help you with your order! To get started, could you please provide the email address associated with your account? This will help me locate your order and assist you further. If you don't remember your email, you can provide your first name, last name, and zip code instead.
user: Sure, my zip code is 91148.
assistant: Thank you! Could you also provide your first name and last name so I can locate your account?

assistant: You have two recent orders:

1. Order #W6750959 (Status: Pending, shipping to Los Angeles) – includes a Bluetooth Speaker and an E-Reader.
2. Order #W3407479 (Status: Processed, shipping to New York) – does not include a Bluetooth Speaker.

Since only pending orders can have their shipping address changed and items exchanged, your request applies to Order #W6750959.

To proceed, I need the following:
1. Your new NYC shipping address (please provide the full address).
2. I will look up the cheapest green Bluetooth speaker option for you to exchange.

Once you provide your NYC address, I’ll confirm all details before making any changes. Could you please provide your full NYC address?
